# Orbit Explorer

> Orbit Explorer is a free interactive space-exploration web app: tour every planet up close, see the real stars within 16 light-years, view the Milky Way with real objects marked, and browse discovered exoplanets. Runs in the browser, no sign-up. Built by Siva Dheeraj.

## What you can explore
- The solar system: every planet rendered up close
- 54 nearby star systems within 16 light-years (real catalog data)
- The Milky Way with real objects marked (galaxy shape is illustrative)
- Known exoplanets

## Links
- App: https://orbit-explorer-psi.vercel.app/
